ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70:30 ratio of high-intensity (white) to low-intensity (black) pixels across the visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Large contiguous high-intensity white regions occupy the central-upper lobes. High-density black mottling is concentrated at the medial notch and extends along the leading and trailing edges. Discrete small-scale low-intensity spots are distributed across the white regions of the left lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with an approximate 85-degree internal angle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern along the trailing edge with pixel-amplitude variations approximately 3% of total fluke height; notable deep indentations on the distal portions of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve profile from the medial notch sweeping into sharp upward convex arcs at the lateral lobe extremities.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark pixel clusters visible along the right lobe's distal edge and textured high-intensity grey clusters at the extreme tip of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: A single, high-contrast near-vertical low-intensity line (rake mark) located on the distal third of the left lobe; faint near-horizontal linear disruptions on the mid-section of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Significant vertical linear scar on the left lobe; irregular notch-like loss of material on the trailing edge margin of the left lobe.
